You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered passages given.

Rules:
- Use only these passages. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the passages do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with the dates in the passages.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several passages answer it, list every one of them.
- If the question asks who does something and within what time, the kind is "text" and the value names both.
- Return JSON only:
  {"kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [passage numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: On 1 December 2026, for Annex IV categories of Directive 2006/42/EC built to harmonised standards covering all the relevant requirements, the manufacturer may use internal checks on manufacture alone. For which of those categories is internal production control (module A) no longer admitted on 1 February 2027, even when harmonised standards are fully applied?

Passages:
[0] REG, Art. 25(4): Article 25 Conformity assessment procedures for machinery and related products. 4. Where the category of machinery or related product is not listed in Annex I, the manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18, shall apply the internal production control procedure (module A) set out in Annex VI.

[1] eu-dir-2014-30, Annex II: ANNEX II MODULE A: INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3, 4 and 5 of this Annex, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the apparatus concerned satisfy the requirements of this Directive that apply to it.

[2] REG, Art. 25(3): Article 25 Conformity assessment procedures for machinery and related products. 3. Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B, the manufacturer or the natural or legal person referred to in Article 18 shall apply one of the following procedures: (a) internal production control (module A) set out in Annex VI; (b) EU type-examination (module B) set out in Annex VII, followed by conformity to type based on internal production control (module C) set out in Annex VIII; (c) conformity based on full quality assurance (module H) set out in Annex IX; (d) conformity based on unit verification (module G) set out in Annex X. If a manufacturer applies the internal production control procedure referred to in point (a), it shall design and construct the machinery or related product in accordance with the harmonised standards or common specifications specific to that category of machinery or related product covering all the relevant essential health and safety requirements. Where the category of machinery or related product is listed in Annex I, Part B, and the machinery or related product was not designed and constructed in accordance with the harmonised standards or common specifications specific to that category of machinery or related product covering all the relevant essential health and safety requirements for that category of machinery or related product, the manufacturer, including a natural or legal person referred to in Article 18, shall apply one of the procedures referred to in points (b), (c) or (d) of this paragraph.

[3] eu-reg-2016-425, Annex IV: ANNEX IV INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL (Module A) 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the PPE concerned satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

[4] REG, Annex VI: ANNEX VI INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL (Module A) 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on its sole responsibility that the machinery or related product concerned satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

[5] eu-dir-2014-34, Annex VIII: ANNEX VIII MODULE A: INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the products concerned satisfy the requirements of this Directive that apply to them.

[6] eu-dir-2014-34, Annex VI: ANNEX VI MODULE C1: CONFORMITY TO TYPE BASED ON INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL PLUS SUPERVISED PRODUCT TESTING 1. Conformity to type based on internal production control plus supervised product testing is the part of a conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the products concerned are in conformity with the type described in the EU-type examination certificate and satisfy the requirements of this Directive that apply to them.

[7] eu-dir-2014-35, Annex III: ANNEX III MODULE A Internal production control 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the electrical equipment concerned satisfy the requirements of this Directive that apply to it.

[8] eu-dir-2014-68, Annex III, 1: 1. MODULE A: (INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL) 1. Internal production control is the conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2, 3 and 4, and ensures and declares on his sole responsibility that the pressure equipment concerned satisfy the requirements of this Directive.

[9] eu-reg-2016-425, Annex VI: ANNEX VI CONFORMITY TO TYPE BASED ON INTERNAL PRODUCTION CONTROL (Module C) 1. Conformity to type based on internal production control is the part of a conformity assessment procedure whereby the manufacturer fulfils the obligations laid down in points 2 and 3, and ensures and declares under his sole responsibility that the PPE concerned is in conformity with the type described in the EU type-examination certificate and satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation.

response.text: {"kind": "unknown", "value": null, "text": "The passages do not state any date-based change for module A on 1 February 2027. Article 25(3) of the Machinery Regulation allows internal production control (module A) for Annex I Part B categories only when the machinery is designed and constructed to the applicable harmonised standards or common specifications, but they set no cut-off date.", "used": [2]}
